provenance.prior_evidence_used: Known small-parser failure on previous boundary-choice-v1 panel informed this new design; these exact new texts have not been parsed.

expectation_policy: expected_rule_candidate:null is unspecified. guard_must_reject:true requires a tested changed or unresolved guard; false imposes no guard-pass expectation. Missing/error guards remain unavailable. Supplementary panel stays separate from the prior 24-case panel.
